guidance.summary: Net new deal adding over $125 million annually
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: So, from this deal perspective, this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

guidance.summary: Aspiration to scale company revenue to $5 billion by FY31
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: Many of you have asked us in Earning Calls before, do we need additional verticals to scale to the aspiration of $5 billion that we have? By FY31, we get that as well at a nice scale.

guidance.summary: Target to have European business at 15% plus of revenues
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: We add to the European business, we live to our dream of having European business at 15% plus.

guidance.summary: Net Debt to EBITDA leverage expected to reduce to 1X by FY30
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
guidance.quote: So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.
